deviations.description: Rule B is under-detected. Layer-1 unit 2, which should switch off when cov > mand_lim, also carries a term of about +0.08*forced from mand_in_ptv and ptv_vol. So when the mandible is forced into the PTV and cov exceeds mand_lim by less than roughly 0.35 Gy per cc of forced overlap, the network sends the request to planning instead of escalating it.
deviations.condition: (mand_in_ptv - 0.05*ptv_vol > 0.4) and (cov > mand_lim + 0.3) and (cov - mand_lim < 0.35*(mand_in_ptv - 0.0485*ptv_vol)) and (cov <= cap) and (cord_lim >= cord_floor) and (missing == 0)
